notes_for_editor: Only the register and one OpenStreetMap node describe this tower. No history, staffing or fire record was found after two searches and a few reads. The register flags the location as not verified, so the coordinates may be approximate. OpenStreetMap agrees on 30 m height and metal construction. Excluded: a US archive photo caption for a 'Tepee Lake' lookout (Sec. 17, T46N, R37W, built by the CCC), which is a different site. Access 'restricted' is an editorial level from working status, not a stated rule. Brief's access 'closed' is not supported as a site status.
